detail.setupPlace: {{remaining}} influence left to place, one per click.
detail.bidPlace: Only in countries that already have US influence; both may go to the same country.
detail.headlineSeen: Space Race privilege: the {{side}} headline is {{card}}.
detail.headlineFirst: The {{side}} holds the Space Race privilege and sees your headline first.
detail.actionCard: {{plays}} card plays left this turn, including this one. Scoring cards in hand: {{scoring}}.
detail.playModeOpponent: A {{side}} card: if you use it for Operations, its Event happens for the {{side}} (Event first, or after your Ops).
detail.playModeScoring: A scoring card is played as its Event.
detail.influence: Each click adds 1 influence; a country your opponent controls costs 2 Ops.
detail.realign: Each click rolls once in the chosen country; press Done to stop early.
detail.eventCardDone: Press Done when you have finished.
detail.coup_one: Roll + {{count}} Op must beat 2 × stability. A coup in a battleground degrades DEFCON by 1.
detail.coup_other: Roll + {{count}} Ops must beat 2 × stability. A coup in a battleground degrades DEFCON by 1.
detail.playModeOwn_one: Event, Space Race, or Operations worth {{count}} Op.
detail.playModeOwn_other: Event, Space Race, or Operations worth {{count}} Ops.
detail.playModeNeutral_one: A neutral card: the Event happens for you, or use its {{count}} Op.
detail.playModeNeutral_other: A neutral card: the Event happens for you, or use its {{count}} Ops.
